mapper.insert: INSERT INTO refresh_token (member_id, token_hash, expires_at, created_at) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{tokenHash}, #{expiresAt}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, member_id, token_hash, expires_at, created_at, rotated_at FROM refresh_token WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} FOR UPDATE
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM refresh_token WHERE expires_at < NOW() OR (rotated_at IS NOT NULL AND rotated_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '1 minute')
